title: In 2018, it makes way more sense to buy a $1,000 Apple iPhone than a $1,000 Apple laptop (AAPL)
text: In 2018, it makes way more sense to buy a $1,000 Apple iPhone than a $1,000 Apple laptop (AAPL) By Matt Weinberger Sep 15, 2018, 11:11 am 33 pts With the iPhone X, Apple normalized the $1,000 smartphone. The just-announced iPhone XS and XS Max will take that torch and run with it, starting at that same price. The thing is that it actually makes sense to buy an iPhone X, or other high-end smartphones.
